text:
sam: Heads up 1: new checklist item from cloud partnerships: ensure marketplace SKU IDs match finance ledger codes. We keep getting reconciliation delays.
olivia: I can own mapping. Proposal: prefix SKUs with RW-<cloud>-<env>-<size> (e.g., RW-AWS-GA-CPU2). Finance wants a CSV with ledger_code column.
rafa: Azure question: can we include both BYOL and included-license images in one offer? That affects our product packaging.
legal-bot: New issue created: LEG-901 "Marketplace billing & licensing terms" assigned to rafa, olivia.
olivia: For BYOL, we should list license terms in the marketplace listing and include a link to T&C. Also need a 2-line cancellation policy to display.
rafa: Ops note: Azure supports VM size options under a single offer; for BYOL we need to ensure the license checkbox appears during purchase. Confirming with partner center docs.
sam: For AWS/GCP, metered usage is straightforward, but we need to ensure our usage reporting endpoint meets their usage-report format (CSV push). Can someone confirm telemetry export format?
olivia: I'll coordinate with eng for a sample usage CSV and include a mapping example in the CSV export.
legal-bot: Reminder: short data handling statement required. Suggested snippet: "Redwood processes inference requests; we retain token-level metadata for billing and diagnostics. Customers may request exclusion of metadata retention for Private/Dedicated plans."
rafa: Good. Also need to include encryption line: "All data in transit is TLS-encrypted; Private deployments can integrate with customer KMS."
olivia: Action items: olivia = produce SKU->ledger CSV + one-line marketplace descriptors by Fri; rafa = confirm BYOL pass-through flow + Azure checkbox by Thu; sam = sample usage export format and telemetry endpoint by Wed.
marketplace-bot: Checklist updated: partners/marketplace#890 steps added.
sam: tiny nit 1: ensure AMI naming convention doesn't expose internal build metadata. Use build hash only.
olivia: noted. will mask any CI tags.
legal-bot: Please attach the final legal blurb to the marketplace listing draft.
raf: will do. thanks team.
